Full summary: Task 3 (/api/blackboard/:id detail endpoint) implemented via subagent, TDD green (11/11 endpoint tests, full suite 1125 pass, tsc clean), plus a regression test pinning the legacy /api/blackboard list route. Review subagent running; commit follows approval.
Findings: Route ids are not URL-decoded in /api/blackboard/:id — deliberate consistency with the existing /api/decisions/:id and /api/handoffs/:id convention (also undecoded); ULIDs never need decoding.
